metadata.title: Mapping class group actions on the cohomology of configuration spaces of surfaces
metadata.abstract: Let X be a closed oriented surface of genus at least 2 and P a finite subset of X. We bound the action of the mapping class group of (X,P) on the rational cohomology groups of the ordered configuration spaces F_n(X-P) of X-P. In particular, we show that, when #P < 2, the diagonal action of the mapping class group on the direct sum of the H^n(F_n(X-P)) is faithful, and determine its kernel when #P > 1.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 配置空间上同调的映射类群作用
analysis.workSummary: 对亏格至少2的闭定向曲面X及有限子集P，研究(X,P)映射类群在有序配置空间F_n(X−P)的有理上同调上的作用。作者证明当|P|<2时，该群在各n的H^n直和上的对角作用忠实，并在|P|>1时确定其核。
techniques: 映射类群对角作用及核
analysis.breakthrough: 用跨配置点数的中次数上同调检测低穿孔数的映射类群元素，并分析更多穿孔的核。
analysis.limitations: 忠实性针对直和对角作用。摘要未说明单一n是否忠实或核的具体描述，也未给整数系数结果。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 低维拓扑的群作用识别结果。
